title: "Shabbar De Janaze Te Ainj Ghazi Farz Nibhaye Lyrics In Punjabi 2023"
language: "Panjabi"
lang: "pa"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Other"
poet: "Sabir"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []
published: false
---

1
Shabbar De Janaze Te Ainj Ghazi Farz Nibhaye.
Kadi Lash Nu Sanbhalay Kadi Teraan Taun Banaye.
Kuhram Ik Bapa Si Wehray Che Fatima De.
Maiyyat Choon Teer Zainab, Kulsoom Jad Hataye.

2
Shabbir Janday Ne Yaan Jandi Aye Zainab.
Paiwast Teer Kiwein Lashay Choon Bar Aaye.
Jodah Ne Zehar De Ke Kita Qatal Mujtaba Da.
Chalni Badan Si Kita Ummat Ne Fair Haye.

3
Tasbeeh e Fatima De Khilray Ne Jiwein Moti.
Ohwein Jigar De Tukray Seene Choon Bar Aaye.
Jis Seene Wich Samaya Haye Pyar Syeda Da.
Oss Seene Wich Ne Lokaan Haye Teer Hun Chalaye.

4
Ro Aakhda Si Ghazi Mil Jandi Jay Ijazat.
Koi Addo Na Bach Ke Yasrab Choon Bar Jaye.
Tareekh Wich Janaza Na Ghar Nu Mur Ke Aaya.
Maiyyat Kisay V Sabir Aynj Kafan Do Na Paye.

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re, subprocess
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/shabbar-de-janaze-te-ainj-ghazi-farz-nibhaye-lyrics-in-punjabi-2023-tajpoints-f109d177f31a5ed6ba01.md')
s = p.read_text().replace('چوں بر ', 'چوں بار ').replace('سمایا ہائے پیار', 'سمایا ہے پیار')
p.write_text(s)
old = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', f'HEAD:{p}'], text=True).split('---', 2)[2]
_, yaml, body = s.split('---', 2)
roman = yaml.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1]
def blocks(value):
    return [b.splitlines() for b in re.split(r'\\n\\s*\\n', value.strip())]
assert [[l.strip().rstrip('.').casefold() for l in b] for b in blocks(old)] == [[l.strip().casefold() for l in b] for b in blocks(roman)]
assert [b[0] for b in blocks(body)] == list('۱۲۳۴')
assert [len(b) for b in blocks(body)] == [5]*4
assert '\\u200c' not in body
print('Verified 16 Roman verses and four matching Shahmukhi stanza blocks.')

print('Verified four stanzas of four verses in each script.')

item.text:
Reconstructed all 16 Punjabi verses in Shahmukhi and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Verified that both versions have four stanzas of four verses. Updated the title and right-to-left metadata and removed the resolved `noUrdu` tag.

I read the ambiguous Roman “Addo” as `عدو` (“enemy”).
